title: DNA extraction (phenol/chloroform)
summary: Classical organic-extraction DNA prep. Higher yield and purity than columns for large genomes; rarely first-line, often last-line.
hazardsMd: Phenol burns through skin and gives off toxic vapor. ALL phenol work in the fume hood, full PPE (lab coat, double gloves, safety glasses). Phenol-contaminated waste goes in a designated phenol-waste bottle, never down the drain.
contentUndergrad:
## Why ever do this
Kit columns cap out at ~50 μg. For genomic preps from tissue or large plasmids (>50 kb), phenol/chloroform still gives the best yield + length distribution. Save it for when you've outgrown silica.

steps.title: Lyse + Proteinase K digest
steps.instructionMd: Suspend sample in lysis buffer (TE + 1% SDS + 100 μg/mL Proteinase K). Incubate 56 °C / 1-2 h until clear.
steps.verificationMd: Suspension goes from cloudy to translucent. No remaining tissue chunks.

steps.title: Phenol:chloroform extraction
steps.instructionMd: In the fume hood: add equal volume phenol:chloroform:isoamyl. Invert 50× (do not vortex — shears DNA). Spin 10 min at 13,000×g. Carefully pipette top aqueous layer to a new tube — avoid the white interface.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Pipette tips that touch phenol go into phenol-waste, not the regular trash.
steps.verificationMd: Three layers visible after spin: aqueous (top, clear), interface (white), organic (bottom, yellow).

steps.title: Chloroform back-extraction
steps.instructionMd: Repeat with equal volume chloroform alone. Invert + spin as before. Take aqueous to a new tube.
steps.verificationMd: Two layers; aqueous on top. Interface should be much thinner than the first round.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instructionMd: Add 1/10 volume 3 M NaOAc + 2.5 volumes cold 100% ethanol. Invert. Incubate −20 °C for 30 min (or overnight). Spin 30 min at 13,000×g 4 °C.
steps.verificationMd: Visible white pellet at the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Wash + resuspend
steps.instructionMd: Carefully aspirate supernatant. Add 500 μL cold 70% ethanol. Spin 10 min. Aspirate; air-dry the pellet 5 min. Resuspend in 50-200 μL TE or water.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Don't over-dry — pellet becomes hard to resuspend. Don't under-dry — residual ethanol inhibits enzymes.
steps.verificationMd: Pellet fully dissolved. NanoDrop reads A260/A280 ≈ 1.8, A260/A230 > 2.0.
